children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 2, with investors reacting to corporate developments.

Coal India share price rose 3% after UBS maintained 'buy' rating on Coal India with a target price of ₹550 per share. UBS expects strong thermal coal demand and lower inventories to support higher e-auction premiums, while overall coal demand remains strong despite weaker production trends.

Gland Pharma share price fell 1% despite company received zero Form 483 observations after United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) conducted a routine Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) inspection at the company’s VSEZ Sterile Oncology formulations facility and API facility in Visakhapatnam between August 24 and September 1, 2026.

Adani Green Energy share price jumped 2% after its wholly owned step-down subsidiary Adani Green Energy Twenty Six A Limited has operationalised a 139 MW solar power project at Khavda, Gujarat. With the operationalisation of this project, the company has achieved a total operational renewable generation capacity of 20,280.80 MW and total operational battery energy storage system (BESS) capacity of 3,551 MWh.
All the sectoral indices were trading in the red with media, IT, auto, Realty, consumer durables down 1-2%.
The broader market trading lower, with Nifty Midcap falling 1% and Smallcap index shed 0.6%.
Market breadth remained weak on the BSE, with 1351 shares advancing, 2109 declining and 168 remaining unchanged, indicating a broadly negative trend across the broader market.

title: Price Action: Coal India shares up 3% as UBS maintains 'buy'; Adani Green Energy jumps 2%
